notes.title: Path to Serenity - Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm pleased to announce that Path to Serenity will be released on the 16th of June. It has been an incredible journey to reach this milestone, and I want to express my gratitude to everyone who has provided feedback and support along the way.

Path to Serenity will be available on Steam, Itch.io, and the Humble Store starting June 16th. For every unit sold on these platforms, I will donate $0.10 to the Safe in Our World charity.

I hope you'll enjoy Path to Serenity and its message, which is dear to my heart: finding happiness in life. For me, that means spending more time at home with my son and family, creating games, and building my studio. I believe everyone has their own path to happiness.

Thank you once again for wishlisting my game and for reading my posts.

Silviu
